# Unisen

> Unisen is SEND coordination software for schools (SENCOs) and families working through EHC needs assessments in England — shared timelines, statutory deadlines, and execution assistance.

Unisen is not a local-authority case system and does not replace statutory processes. It helps schools answer LA consultations and helps families review draft EHC plans in one workspace.

## Primary

- [Home](https://senco-flow.vercel.app/): Product overview for schools, SENCOs, and families
- [Sitemap](https://senco-flow.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs

## Product surfaces (authenticated; not for public indexing)

- School workspace: consultations, calendar, templates, reports, school profile
- Family workspace: draft EHC plan review, issues, response preparation

## Contact

- Product site: https://senco-flow.vercel.app/
